In today's computer architecture lecture, we explore the Neural Processing Unit or NPU. Snapdragon X Series processors contain dedicated Hexagon NPU hardware designed to accelerate on-device artificial intelligence workloads efficiently. Unlike classical CPUs that handle general computing tasks, NPUs excel at matrix multiplication and quantized integer tensor operations required for neural networks like Whisper and Phi-3. By executing AI models locally on the NPU, laptops achieve extended battery life, zero cloud latency, and absolute data privacy since no sensitive audio or notes leave the device.
